words.definition: a person you know well and like
words.example: She is my best friend.

words.definition: kind and nice to other people
words.example: Our new neighbor is very friendly.

words.definition: a person who lives near you
words.example: My neighbor helps me with my garden.

words.definition: a group of people who live in the same area
words.example: Our community has a nice park.

words.definition: to do something useful for someone
words.example: I help my friend with homework.

words.definition: to use or have something together with other people
words.example: Please share your food with your friend.

words.definition: gentle and caring towards other people
words.example: My teacher is very kind.

words.definition: to move your mouth to show you are happy
words.example: She smiles at everyone she meets.

words.definition: to say words to someone
words.example: We talk on the phone every day.

words.definition: to see and talk to someone for the first time or by plan
words.example: I meet my friends at the park.

words.definition: to say hello to someone
words.example: I greet my neighbors every morning.

words.definition: to ask someone to come to an event
words.example: I invite my friends to my birthday party.

words.definition: a fun event where people meet to celebrate
words.example: We had a great party last night.

words.definition: with each other, not alone
words.example: We study together after school.

words.definition: to believe that someone is honest and good
words.example: I trust my best friend.

words.definition: to think that someone or something is important to you
words.example: Good friends care about each other.

words.definition: to help other people without being paid
words.example: We volunteer at the community center on Sundays.

words.definition: a number of people who do something together
words.example: Our group cleaned the park.

words.definition: to be friendly and happy when someone arrives
words.example: We welcome new students at our school.

words.definition: to help and encourage someone
words.example: Friends support each other in hard times.

text: Making friends is easy when you are kind and friendly. When I meet new people, I try to smile and talk to them. Last month, a new family moved next door. I wanted to welcome them, so I went to greet my new neighbor. We talked for a long time, and now we are friends. I invited her to a party at my house, and she met many people from our community. We all had fun together. In our neighborhood, there is a friendly group of people who help each other. Sometimes we volunteer to clean the park or help older neighbors carry heavy bags. I like to share my things with my friends, and I always try to care about their problems. Good friends trust each other and support each other when life is hard. I feel happy because I have many kind friends in my community. When people work together and help each other, everyone feels welcome and safe. This is why community is so important to me.
